# GPT-Neo 2.7B

EleutherAI · released 2021-03 · 2.7B params · mit

**score 51.8** ±1.4 · #15 of 39 · from 14 benchmark results across 3 sources

Score within the [ARC Challenge](https://whatmodel.sh/?set=arc-challenge) comparison set only.

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

<pre>
download        size  score
4-bit fp32  ~10.67GB   51.8
</pre>

```sh
# 4-bit fp32
uv run --with torch --with 'transformers<5' python -c "from transformers import pipeline; print(pipeline('text-generation', model='EleutherAI/gpt-neo-2.7B')('Once upon a time', max_new_tokens=40)[0]['generated_text'])"
```

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>
